behavior.batching: First fragment publishes immediately; later adjacent fragments flush at a nominal 24ms or 8192 UTF-16 code-unit threshold, without splitting an individual provider fragment. Closing success, failure or cancellation flushes pending received text and clears timers.
behavior.snapshotConsistency: partialAnswer advances only with published events, so a log snapshot cannot include a tail that a future delta will publish again.
behavior.atomicProtocol: Local events retain startSequence === sequence. The renderer appends these; only a real startSequence < sequence text range replaces earlier fragments for its key. Compiled assets are regenerated from authored compiler patches; archived inputs are unchanged.
behavior.detailRetention: Unopened tasks retain metadata only. Only explicitly loaded, still-cached details receive live text. In-flight snapshots defer incoming detail changes to one trailing refresh; repeated user-message events update the existing message and attachment metadata.
behavior.logRetention: After the existing 500-log retention save succeeds, evicted task logs emit task_log.deleted so each connected renderer drops their summaries and cached details.
behavior.importGate: Oversized-upload validation waits up to 5 seconds for the new toast instead of reading a prior notice after a fixed 80ms.
